cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Make the Choice Rewrite the Past
cards.instruction: Make them choose between options whose consequences reinterpret an earlier promise, refusal, or agreement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've signed the shop lease where you signed. Choose the overseas job or this shop; you said we'd build something together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I signed as a witness. You've put your name in the witness box too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, witnessed intentions. Which of us is signing as the actual partner?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I could take the job and send money for the shop. You'd run it here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then sign as an investor. We'll call 'together' your money and my days behind the counter.
